dimensions.name: Knowledge Delta
dimensions.justification: Provides many non‑obvious expert details (OAC signing behavior options, TLSv1.2_2021 cipher restrictions, exact bucket‑policy condition with AWS:SourceArn, mandatory us-east-1 ACM region, Lambda@Edge region constraint, separation of cache vs origin‑request policies, failover status‑code list, specific awslogsdelivery canonical ID, real‑time logging vs standard, KeyValueStore usage, continuous‑deployment staging workflow, VPC origin support, TLS 1.3 note). These go beyond what a generic model would already know.

dimensions.name: Mindset + Appropriate Procedures
dimensions.justification: Encodes an AWS‑specific step‑by‑step procedure: pre‑flight IAM/ACM checks, OAC creation and bucket‑policy update, custom‑origin protocol enforcement, viewer‑protocol policy selection, TLS minimum version, WAF scope verification, cache/origin‑request policy selection, response‑headers policy construction, origin‑group failover config, geo‑restriction setup, price‑class decision, edge‑compute choice, logging ACL grant, confirmation gate before any state‑changing CLI call. Only minor omission: no explicit procedure for updating an existing distribution.

dimensions.name: Anti-Pattern Quality
dimensions.justification: Contains a thorough NEVER list with concrete reasons (e.g., never use S3 website endpoint, never set MinimumProtocolVersion below TLSv1.2_2021). Slight deduction for missing a few cost‑related anti‑patterns (e.g., over‑using PriceClass_All without justification).

dimensions.name: Specification Compliance
dimensions.justification: Frontmatter is complete (name, description, version, author, license, compatibility, keywords, tags, metadata, activation triggers, invocation schema). Description clearly states WHAT the skill does, WHEN to invoke, and provides rich keywords, meeting all compliance criteria.

dimensions.name: Progressive Disclosure
dimensions.justification: Layers information well: high‑level Mindset, quick‑reference checklist, detailed stepwise process, anti‑patterns, edge‑case handling, verification commands, and worked examples. Critical rules are visible early; deeper technical references are deferred.

dimensions.name: Freedom Calibration
dimensions.justification: Destructive actions (create‑distribution, OAC, WAF) are gated by explicit confirmation prompts and pre‑flight safety checks. Creative planning steps are left open for interactive refinement. Calibration matches task fragility.

dimensions.name: Pattern Recognition
dimensions.justification: Follows a recognizable pattern (Mindset → Quick reference → Process steps → Output format → Worked example → Verification → Edge‑case & Anti‑pattern sections). Structure is consistent, though a few sections (e.g., anti‑patterns) could be more formally integrated.

dimensions.name: Practical Usability
dimensions.justification: Provides decision trees, a ready‑to‑use checklist, concrete AWS CLI commands, verification steps, and remediation guidance. Model outputs for sample specs are correct (READY_TO_DEPLOY or PREREQUISITES_MISSING) and include full command lists, showing the skill can be executed end‑to‑end. Minor gap: no explicit handling of VPC‑origin IAM role creation.
